translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
qasam hai burjon walay aasman ki ,
aur uss din ki jiss ka wada kiya gaya hai ,
aur hazir honey walay ki aur uss ki jiss kay paas log hazir hon ,
kay khuda ki maar hai unn khandaq ( khodney ) walon per
uss aag walon per jo endhan say bhari hoi thi ,
jab woh uss kay paas bethay thay ,
aur woh emaan walon kay sath jo kuch ker rahey thay , uss ka nazara kertay jatay thay .
aur woh emaan walon ko kissi aur baat ki nahi , sirf iss baat ki saza dey rahey thay kay woh uss Allah per emaan ley aaye thay jo baray iqtidar wala , boht qabil-e-tareef hai .
jiss kay qabazay mein saray aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat hai . aur Allah her cheez ko dekh raha hai .

yaqeen rakho kay jinn logon  ney momin mardon aur momin aurton ko zulm ka nishana banaya hai , phir tauba nahi ki hai , unn kay liye jahannum ka azab hai , aur unn ko aag mein jalney ki saza di jaye gi .
jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye beyshak ( jannat kay ) aesay baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain . yeh hai bari kamiyabi !
haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay perwerdigar ki pakar boht sakht hai .
wohi pehli martaba peda kerta hai aur wohi dobara peda keray ga .
aur woh boht bakhshney wala , boht mohabbat kernay wala hai ,
arsh ka malik hai , buzurgi wala hai ,
jo kuch irada kerta hai , ker guzarta hai .
kiya tumharay paas unn lashkaron ki khabar phonchi hai .
firon aur samood ( kay lashkaron ) ki-?
iss kay bawajood kafir log haq ko jhutlaney mein lagay huye hain ,
jabkay Allah ney unn ko gheray mein liya huwa hai .
. ( unn kay jhutlaney say Quran per koi asar nahi parrta ) balkay yeh bari azmat wala Quran hai ,
jo loah-e-mehfooz mein darj hai .
